title: Trump-Xi Summit Puts Nvidia, Boeing And 500-Jet Deal In Focus
title_zh: 特习峰会聚焦英伟达、波音和 500 架喷气式飞机交易
summary: Investors are watching chips, aerospace, agriculture and rare earths as Trump and Xi head into high-stakes talks.
summary_zh: 随着特朗普和习近平进行高风险会谈，投资者正在关注芯片、航空航天、农业和稀土。

title: Microsoft's OpenAI Deal Pulls Cash Forward
title_zh: 微软与 OpenAI 交易拉动现金
summary: OpenAI's revenue-sharing payments to Microsoft are reportedly capped at $38 billion through 2030.
summary_zh: 据报道，到 2030 年，OpenAI 向微软支付的收入分成上限为 380 亿美元。

title: Salesforce’s Air Force Deal Tests Agentforce’s Role In Secure Government AI
title_zh: Salesforce 的空军交易测试了 Agentforce 在保护政府人工智能方面的作用
summary: Salesforce secured a $72 million U.S. Air Force agreement as part of a broader $5.6 billion Department of Defense contract. The deal brings Salesforce's Agentforce AI platform into Air Force and Space Force operations for personnel and workflow management.
summary_zh: Salesforce 获得了价值 7200 万美元的美国空军协议，作为更广泛的 56 亿美元国防部合同的一部分。该交易将 Salesforce 的 Agentforce AI 平台引入空军和太空军的人员和工作流程管理。

title: The PE Paradox: Volatility Fuels New Deals as Old Assets Sit Frozen in Portfolios
title_zh: 私募股权悖论：旧资产在投资组合中冻结，波动性助长新交易
summary: Glinting investment opportunities abound, private-equity firms say—but the industry also faces an exit bottleneck of over $3 trillion.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司表示，闪闪发光的投资机会比比皆是，但该行业也面临着超过 3 万亿美元的退出瓶颈。

title: Sony Music Publishing Lands Iconic Song Catalog In Major Blackstone Deal
title_zh: 索尼音乐出版公司在 Blackstone 重大交易中获得标志性歌曲目录
summary: Sony Group Corporation (NYSE:SONY) shares traded higher Wednesday as investors reacted to a major music catalog acquisition by the company's publishing arm and continued buying into large-cap growth and entertainment stocks.
summary_zh: 索尼集团公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：SONY）周三股价走高，因投资者对该公司出版部门收购音乐目录做出反应，并继续买入大盘成长型和娱乐股。
